Subject: Double charge for crown fitting

Hello, I'm writing about my visit to Harbourside Dental on 22 October, when Dr Ngata fitted the crown on my lower left molar. My bank statement shows two payments of £385.00 on 23 October, not one. Mereana Ruatapu at reception said on 28 October that she could see only one payment on your system and would ask the accounts team, but I haven't heard back from Mereana since. The card used was 4111 1111 1111 1111. My patient number is HD-55102 and my dental insurance policy is DPX-7781-204; the insurer will only reimburse 50% once the duplicate is reversed. Please refund £385.00 to the same card within 14 days or call me on 07700 900233.

Thanks,
Teodora Vasilescu
task: Polish this complaint so it's firm but polite and makes the refund deadline clear.

text: Hi, could you help me write to Thornbury Talking Therapies? My GP, Dr Eilidh MacAskill, referred me on 3 November for anxiety and panic attacks that started in August. My insurer has approved eight sessions, not twelve as the GP letter says, and the approval code only works if the first session happens before 31 January. I was told the therapist would be Nguyen Thi Lan. I'd like to stay with Lan if possible because a friend saw her and found her easy to talk to, but I'm open to someone else if the wait is long. I can do Tuesday or Wednesday evenings after 6pm, not mornings. My NHS number is 999 123 4567, insurer membership AXM-30027716, mobile 07700 900871, email jo.bramwell@example.net, and my address is 7 Linden Close, Thornbury BS35 2XX.
task: Help me write a short first email to the therapy service to book my first session.

Notes from Tuesday's leave planning call (HR: Grigore Popescu; manager: Ifeoma Chukwu; employee: Hana Kobayashi)
- Hana's parental leave starts 2 February, not 9 February as in the first draft; Grigore corrected this against the signed form.
- Enhanced pay is 16 weeks at full salary, then statutory pay; it is not 18 weeks, which was the old policy.
- Hana may add up to 4 weeks of annual leave at the end, but she hasn't decided and doesn't need to until 1 April.
- Phased return: 3 days a week for the first 4 weeks, only if Ifeoma signs off the cover plan by 15 January.
- Ifeoma said she'd probably approve, but wants the contractor confirmed first.
- Keeping-in-touch days: up to 10, paid, none mandatory.
task: Draft a friendly confirmation email to the employee setting out exactly what was agreed and what is still open.
